inputPolicy: explicit highest canonical score among surfaced options; original human tape unavailable

definitions.central: Last 512 candidate-action rows, potentially multiple intents per receiver; availability counts distinct carrier/receiver episodes. Exact released action scored in the preceding 25ms context.
definitions.network: Intended attempts/completions and actual receiving edges are separate. Full player public counters are retained.
definitions.sequence: Maximum observed in a 64-pass window; detailed rows are last 256. A return-area flag is diagnostic only.

pressure.holdDefinitions: Pressure band at the terminal sample of a control episode; completed episodes only. Duration is not stationary high-pressure stall.

adjacentEvidence.audit: Incoming first-time release is intercepted on its next physical segment. The old challenge/contact/aerial records predate this event; no duplicate acquisition is inferred from them.
